what: released PDE-Transformer sc-s fine-tuned with the paper's recipe (upstream main.py, separate channels, one-step supervised MSE, EMA 0.999) on the task's PDEArena Navier-Stokes training pool; best-validation checkpoint exported by environment/reference/pde_transformer_finetune/export_package.py and replayed through tests/main_verifier.py
protocol: task protocol: canonical split (environment/data/split.json), all 1,185 held-out cases, sealed contract; the model conditions on one frame (upstream sc-s recipe, timesteps=2), so it is given the last of the four context frames; per-dataset model, only the pdearena/navier_stokes_2d group is a real forecast

training.stopped_by: the run's six-hour wall-clock cap (timeout sent SIGTERM during epoch 9); validation loss improved at every one of the eight completed epochs, so this checkpoint is not converged
training.initialization: released sc-s checkpoint (thuerey-group/pde-transformer @ d5889aab), i.e. an external-target reference, not a from-scratch row
deviations_from_the_recipe: "buoyancy" appended to upstream's constant vocabulary (environment/reference/pde_transformer_finetune/patch_constant_vocabulary.py): convert_constants raises ValueError without it. Appending is what upstream's own note sanctions - every existing index keeps its meaning, and the class embedding table is sized by num_classes (1000 rows), not by the vocabulary, so the released weights load unchanged and index 36 is an untrained row.

test_unrolling_steps reduced from 29 to 12: PDEArena trajectories are 14 frames long, so upstream's test dataset cannot cut a 30-frame window. Training and validation use unrolling_steps; upstream's test loop is unused here.

normalization.what: the fine-tune's data pipeline normalizes with MeanStdNorm (normalize_data: mean-std, normalize_const: mean-std), so the package applies the same statistics, taken from the converted training file, and inverts them on the output

metadata_classes.what: Fields and Constants are indices into upstream's fixed vocabularies (pdetransformer/data/metadata_remapping.py), encoded with convert_fields / convert_constants, not positionally

interpretation: 0.7555 on its own dataset is far behind the from-scratch CNextU-net (0.2978) and behind DPOT-Ti zero-shot (0.7455), but it is the only one of the three fine-tunes to beat persistence (1.6490) by a wide margin and the only one to beat the spatial-mean control (1.0004). Two effects hold it back: the sc-s recipe conditions on a single frame (timesteps=2) and is trained on a one-step objective, so a 10-step free-running rollout compounds error, while the task supplies four frames; and only 8 of the 50 requested epochs fit in the six-hour cap, with validation loss still falling at the end.

derivation.what: recomputed on 2026-09-22 from this report's own per-dataset means after removing the corpus family 'ape2d/hyp' (upstream ships hyp.hdf5 as a content copy of diff.hdf5); per-dataset numbers are the measured ones, group means and the reward follow score.py's aggregation exactly; case counts are the canonical split's (environment/data/split.json); the per-dataset means come from the run's verifier report.json and are now embedded
